title: Digital biomarker therapy trial with incomplete twelve-week outcomes

findings.title: Attrition is high or imbalanced across arms
findings.evidence: Arm attrition ranges from 8.3% to 28.8%; spread is 20.5%.
findings.action: Add a CONSORT-style attrition table, explain arm-specific loss, and run an attrition sensitivity analysis.
findings.requirement: Auto peer-review reports should flag reproducibility and statistical rigor risks.

findings.title: Primary outcome missingness lacks a prespecified handling plan
findings.evidence: week12-functional-score has 44 missing values (18.5% of randomized participants).
findings.action: Specify the missing-data estimand, assumptions, imputation model, and sensitivity analyses before reviewer-ready claims are generated.
findings.requirement: Assistant must produce reviewer-ready action packets for reproducibility gaps.

findings.title: Confirmatory analysis relies on weak imputation
findings.evidence: Configured imputation method is "single mean imputation".
findings.action: Use multiple imputation or a justified likelihood-based model, report diagnostics, and compare complete-case, imputed, and MNAR scenarios.
findings.requirement: Assistant should detect statistical methodology risks before peer-review packets are shown.

findings.title: Outcome-related missingness has no MNAR sensitivity analysis
findings.evidence: week12-functional-score: intervention dropouts had worse week-four scores and more adverse-event discontinuations
findings.action: Add delta-adjusted, tipping-point, pattern-mixture, or selection-model sensitivity scenarios and calibrate claim strength to the worst credible scenario.
findings.requirement: Research-gap and reproducibility checks should surface missing sensitivity evidence.

findings.title: Complete-case and imputed estimates materially disagree
findings.evidence: Complete-case estimate 0.42; imputed estimate 0.21; relative shift 100%.
findings.action: Report both estimates, explain the assumed missingness mechanism, and avoid definitive language until sensitivity estimates are reconciled.
findings.requirement: AI review output should calibrate claims against analysis stability.

findings.title: Worst credible missing-data scenario undercuts the main claim
findings.evidence: delta-adjusted scenario reduces the effect to 0.05 and crosses the null threshold
findings.action: Downgrade the conclusion, disclose the sensitivity result, and mark the finding as exploratory or unresolved.
findings.requirement: Assistant should connect analysis checks to claim-strength calibration.

findings.title: Dropout reasons are not reviewer-ready
findings.evidence: 24 of 44 dropout reasons are unknown or not reported.
findings.action: Resolve or group dropout reasons and identify whether missingness is plausibly independent of outcome.
findings.requirement: Peer-review assistant should surface documentation gaps.

findings.title: Claim wording is stronger than the missing-data evidence supports
findings.evidence: Claim "The intervention conclusively improves twelve-week functional recovery." relies on complete-case-only evidence while primary outcome missingness is 18.5%.
findings.action: Calibrate language to conditional complete-case evidence or require imputed and MNAR sensitivity support.
findings.requirement: Assistant should produce reviewer-ready claim revision tasks.
